Which district has the higher population density in 2025, Ossbridge or Ossford, and by how many residents per square kilometre?

Think step by step: first write down every fact you need and the document it comes from, then do the calculations, then compare. Then give the ANSWER line.
End your reply with exactly one final line in this format:
ANSWER: <district name or yes/no> | <number>

- Ossford 2025 population: 30,982 (NR-02); area 846.2 km² (NR-02).

Calculations:
- Ossbridge density: 52,904 / 1,284.6 = 41.1830... residents/km². Let me compute precisely: 1,284.6 × 41 = 52,668.6; remainder 235.4; 235.4 / 1,284.6 = 0.18324. So 41.18324.
- Ossford density: 30,982 / 846.2 = 36.6173... Check: 846.2 × 36 = 30,463.2; remainder 518.8; 518.8 / 846.2 = 0.61305. So 36.61305.
- Difference: 41.18324 − 36.61305 = 4.57019.

Comparison: Ossbridge has the higher population density in 2025, by about 4.570 residents per square kilometre.

ANSWER: Ossbridge | 4.570
